en.answer:
You can activate it.
(You can also activate it by Tributing 1 Reptile monster in your hand or field.)

Also, you can choose the 2nd『●』effect when <<21058>> resolves, but even if chosen you don't take any damage this turn, so the『then you can Special Summon 1 "Mitsurugi" monster from your hand or Graveyard』resolution cannot be applied.
en.question: During a turn in which all damage I take becomes 0 due to the opponent activating a card such as <<14742>>, can I activate <<21058>>?
en.title: Can I activate <<21058>> during a turn in which all damage I take becomes 0?

ja.answer:
発動できます。
（自分の手札・フィールドの爬虫類族モンスター１体をリリースして発動することもできます。）

また、「<<21058>>」の処理時に２つ目の『●』の効果を選ぶこともできますが、選んだ場合でも自分はダメージを受けませんので、『その後、自分の手札・墓地から「巳剣」モンスター１体を特殊召喚できる』処理を適用することはできません。
